name: Heathen The
overview: Scripture reveals that the heathen—those without God and Christ—are the nations among whom God's salvation and righteousness are made known, as seen in Psalms 67 and 98. The psalmist calls for all peoples to praise God and rejoice, highlighting the divine purpose for the heathen to recognize and worship the Lord. This underscores the necessity of proclaiming the gospel to the heathen, so that God's saving health may be known upon the earth and His righteous judgment be acknowledged among all nations.
